interpreted_intent: Independently stage a random, complex photorealistic reference-guided adult portrait inside rain-soaked kinetic infrastructure, with one legible handwheel-turning action and layered physical consequences, so assigned post-core visual semantics can be tested without changing the scene meaning.

setting: A rain-swept elevated transit junction built from connected stormwater gates, rail-switch arms, cable loops, suspended maintenance carriages, grated channels, and repeating steel arches.
event: She braces both gloved hands on a large vermilion handwheel and turns it, visibly opening a connected segmented stormwater gate as runoff spills through the channels below.
visual_priorities: Reference-scoped adult facial structure, evenly spaced almond-shaped eyes, long face, softly tapered medium-width jaw, straight hairline, and long center-parted near-black wavy hair.
The single handwheel-turning action and its physically connected stormwater consequence.
Layered, operationally coherent rain-soaked transit machinery.
baseline_prompt_en: A photorealistic photograph of an unmistakably adult woman with a long oval face, evenly spaced almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, a softly tapered medium-width jaw, a straight dark hairline, and long center-parted near-black wavy hair. She braces both gloved hands on a large vermilion handwheel and turns it beside a rain-swept elevated transit junction. The turning wheel opens a segmented stormwater gate: silver runoff spills through grated channels below while articulated rail-switch arms, cable loops, suspended maintenance carriages, and repeating steel arches extend through layered depth. Her translucent graphite rain shell carries convincing wet fabric weight; droplets bead on her hair and sleeves. Keep the machinery plausible, physically connected, and richly legible as one coherent operational environment.
